author: Grusty
quote:
TLDR - Doesn't feel like GTA. Boring, tedious. Uninspired bland characters (seriously where are all the hilarious nutjob characters) and story. Dull combat that is borderline impossible to lose or die in. Guns that feel like air rifles. Quite a number of features from previous games removed. Often runs poorly. Adds resistance into having fun.

Enemy AI is just as braindead as always, your borderline immortal (no the easy mode was not on). Police chases are a tiny bit harder to evade but only by fraction.  

You can't buy airplanes or have hangers, you don't get your own docks or able to buy boats. You can't buy properties except crappy garages, there are no businesses or passive income or business quest lines. You dont get special vehicle quests like ice cream trucks, vigilante etc.

You can't have fun with guns and arsenal anymore. Limited to running around with a couple of pea shooters and one meh other gun. Guns have no weight, impact, recoil or anything to them. I know shooting in GTA has always been mid at best, but this is not an upgrade its just as mid as ever.

There is more empty space with nothing actually happening than ever, sure there are other cars ncps etc. But the vast majority is just there for visual fluff, it doesn't actually do anything. I can't speak for the amount of side quests or anything as I have not engaged in it that much, but the ones I did do were ok I guess. Nothing great, nothing bad they were just alright.

At no single point is the game challenging.. Which, I do not think is a good or a bad thing its just how it is. Its about as easy and casual as it comes in gaming.

Jason is the single most boring dislikable character in the entire series, Claude in GTA3 has more personality. Other characters while not as brain dead and boring as Jason are mostly just instantly forgettable.

Bike riding is incredibly good funf I'll give it that much.

The graphics are nice but it runs very poorly when anything happens (base PS5), its fine for just driving around chilling but that's about it. I'm someone who really doesn't value graphics and am perfectly happy playing anything from pixel art games to AAA titles. What I value is artwork, and as they went for hyper realism then they just end up with a very generic bland look. A very pretty generic look, but still just generic hyper realism.

Melee combat is a nice upgrade visually but shallow, spam one maybe 2 buttons and you auto win incredibly fast.

Overall it has a very few minor improvements but removed far more than it has added. It also feels like it doesn't want you to have fun and proper freedom, all usual GTA activities just have added layers of resistance. That could be good a thing thing if it's done well but their execution of extra resistance just feels tedious and boring.
